description: Tukuna Porto Espiritual is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O mapa de demarcação apresenta o limite da Terra Indígena Tukuna Porto Espiritual, juntamente com a localização dos municípios e estados, a coordenação regional, superfície e perímetro aproximados, escala, data do mapa, processo administrativo e base cartográfica utilizada. Coverage: Terra Indígena Tukuna Porto Espiritual. Its tags are Tukuna Porto Espiritual, Tikúna, Demarcação, Terra Indígena, Funai. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
